title: Consolidate RepoBrief daily artifact surface
goal: Define and migrate to the smallest RepoBrief/Lenskit artifact set needed for daily agent context for Systemkatalog and other repositories while retaining full reports only for diagnostics and export.

approval.note: User explicitly ordered the next RepoGround task on 2026-07-31. Implementation must remain bound to an isolated RepoGround worktree, exact consumer evidence and review-before-effect.

acceptance.assertion: Actual Grabowski, Systemkatalog and LLM consumers are mapped to the exact fields and artifacts they read.
Manifest, context pack and freshness identity are either confirmed sufficient or replaced by a comparably bounded set.
Redundant formats are deprecated only after compatibility tests and a migration window.
Snapshot and export storage before and after consolidation is measured without weakening citation or freshness guarantees.

basis: Canonical Bureau what-now selected this task as the next RepoGround-affecting operator task after the higher-ranked RepoGround task remained blocked by nonterminal children.
The task has no declared dependencies and its exact write scope is isolated to repo.repoground; Systemkatalog and Grabowski are read-only consumers.
GitHub showed no open RepoGround pull request and Grabowski showed no active RepoGround lease at selection time.
The user supplied explicit operator approval to implement the next RepoGround task.
